cases.name: bounded-mail-search
cases.prompt: Deployment verification: search my own mailbox once for the exact nonsense string CAPIRO_MERI_DIAGNOSTIC_20261002_1616_NO_MATCH. Report only whether search_emails completed successfully or returned an error. Do not disclose email contents, run other tools, save memories, create tasks, or send messages.
cases.visibleToolOutcome: 503 Mail search is temporarily busy. Please retry.
cases.assessment: Answer honestly reported the error without disclosing mailbox contents. The mail operation timed out; this is not a successful tool check.

cases.name: supplied-facts-summary
cases.prompt: Quality check using hypothetical facts only: Aster has a Thursday demo. Maya owns the slides, due Tuesday. Lee owns the technical review, due Wednesday; it depends on Maya finishing the slides. The rehearsal has no owner or scheduled time. Write exactly three concise bullets: the critical path, the main delivery risk, and the next action. Use only these facts. Do not search, use tools, save memories, create tasks, or send messages.
response: Critical path: Maya’s slides due Tuesday → Lee’s technical review due Wednesday → Aster’s Thursday demo.
Main delivery risk: Late slides would delay the dependent technical review; the rehearsal also has no owner or scheduled time.
Next action: Assign a rehearsal owner and schedule it before Thursday’s demo.
cases.contentAssessment: Accurate supplied facts, three requested bullets, useful next action, no invented deadline.
cases.bogusEvidenceFooter: No/none/only/all/every claims require explicit, non-truncated source coverage; an empty or failed query is not proof of absence; that part of the answer remains limited because the source was never called.

cases.name: follow-up-context
cases.prompt: Update to the hypothetical example: the slides will now be ready Wednesday afternoon. Keep the other facts unchanged. In exactly two sentences, explain what this changes and what I should confirm next. Do not assume the demo has been delayed. Do not use tools, save memories, create tasks, or send messages.
cases.response: With slides now arriving Wednesday afternoon, Lee has less time to complete the dependent technical review by Wednesday; the demo remains Thursday. Confirm whether Lee can still meet that deadline, and who will own the rehearsal and when it will happen before the demo.
cases.contentAssessment: Correct context retention, two sentences, recognizes reduced review time without falsely changing the demo date.
cases.bogusEvidenceFooter: Current office, committee, chair, and staff-role claims require a dated current roster; that part of the answer remains limited because the source was called no usable content.

cases.name: missing-information
cases.prompt: Based only on the hypothetical facts in this conversation, what exact time is the rehearsal, and has Lee approved the slides? If either is unknown, say so clearly. Do not infer that a scheduled review means approval happened. Do not search, use tools, save memories, create tasks, or send messages.
response: Rehearsal time: Unknown. No time has been scheduled in the hypothetical facts.
Lee’s approval: Unknown. Lee owns the technical review, but nothing states that Lee has approved the slides.
cases.contentAssessment: Correctly distinguishes absence of information from completed approval; does not invent a time.
cases.bogusEvidenceFooter: No/none/only/all/every claims require explicit, non-truncated source coverage; an empty or failed query is not proof of absence; that part of the answer remains limited because the source was never called.
